# DeepSeek-V4-Flash LAYER 3 reference at five tokens -- the first HCA layer.
#
# Same capture as the layer-0 and layer-1 fixtures:
#   llama-eval-callback -m DeepSeek-V4-Flash-UD-Q4_K_XL-00001-of-00005.gguf \
#     -p "The capital of France is" --no-repack -c 512 -t 12
#
# Format: name|op|shape|sum
#
# WHAT LAYER 3 IS
#
# Heavily Compressed Attention, the simpler of the two compressed kinds and the
# right first target after Raw. 133 rows against Raw's 121 and CSA's 273.
#
# Over a Raw layer it adds exactly three things, all of them state maintenance:
#   hca_state_kv-3          MUL_MAT   {512, 5}    attn_compressor_kv  · x
#   hca_state_score-3       MUL_MAT   {512, 5}    attn_compressor_gate · x
#   hca_state_score_ape-3   ADD       {512, 5}    + attn_compressor_ape[pos]
# written into dsv4_hca_state_{kv,score}_l3 {512, 128} with SET_ROWS.
#
# TWO THINGS THIS CAPTURE CANNOT VERIFY
#
# 1. THE COMPRESSION ITSELF NEVER RUNS. `hca_state_compress` appears zero times
#    in this layer: five tokens do not fill a compression block, so the state is
#    written and never consumed. At this length an HCA layer's attention IS the
#    Raw path plus two extra matmuls. Verifying the compression needs a much
#    longer prompt -- the state is 128 wide, so at least that many tokens.
# 2. Nothing here exercises the indexer; that is CSA's, on the even layers.
#
# WHAT IT *CAN* VERIFY, AND NOTHING BEFORE IT COULD
#
# 1. THE COMPRESSED RoPE BRANCH. compress_ratios[3] != 0, so this layer takes
#    freq_base 160000 with YaRN, and the rotation is real here:
#      q_norm-3 (view)  {64, 64, 5}   4240.427734 -> q_pe-3   3631.148682
#      kv_norm-3 (view) {64,  1, 5}    -94.538872 -> kv_pe-3  -103.840263
#    Deepseek4Config::rope_for_layer's compressed branch is currently
#    transcribed from source and unproven; these two rows are what would prove
#    it.
# 2. THE NORMAL MoE ROUTING PATH, which 40 of 43 layers use and none of the
#    verified work touches. Layers 0-2 are hash layers and select experts by
#    token-id lookup. From layer 3 on it is:
#      ffn_moe_probs_biased-3  ADD      {256, 5}  probs + exp_probs_b
#      ffn_moe_argsort-3       ARGSORT  {256, 5}
#      ffn_moe_topk-3          VIEW     {6, 5}    first 6 of the argsort
#      ffn_moe_weights-3       GET_ROWS {1, 6, 5} from the *unbiased* probs
#    Note the bias steers SELECTION ONLY -- the weights are gathered from the
#    unbiased probabilities. Applying the bias to both is the natural mistake
#    and changes every expert weight without changing a shape.
